{{Top|leg}}
The '''fighting upgrade''' was a module that was designed to give [[Droid/Legends|droids]] a tactical advantage in combat. It increased the sensor range, reflexes and logic systems of a droid.

==Behind the scenes==
A droid must be at upgrade class 1 to be able to equip this item.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''
